### Key Design & Data Highlights

- **Claim**: *"Progress is constant — it never stopped coming, but it never once came on schedule."*
- **Visual Tension**: The 20-year quiet incubation gap ($1969 \rightarrow 1989$) creates a massive breathing zone occupying $\approx 38\%$ of the timeline height, contrasting with the dense 18-year explosion of 5 breakthroughs ($1989 \rightarrow 2007$).
- **Truthful Geometry**: All gap bars start from a verified zero baseline ($0\text{y} \rightarrow 20\text{y}$), and chronological shares sum to the exact 53-year total span.
